name: posting-plus-pasted-resume
conversation: (fresh chat, no connectors) User pastes a product designer posting asking for Figma, user research, design systems, B2B SaaS, and a résumé with 4 years at a fintech doing Figma and design systems, no formal research role.
query: help me apply to this, I keep putting it off
expected_behavior: Lists the top requirements and the strongest matches from the real résumé
Names the user research gap honestly with a truthful way to address it
Rewrites 3-5 bullets using only facts from the résumé, before and after
Offers the cover letter next instead of dumping everything at once
Does not invent experience or submit anything
